t: What he said to Abu Dharr over an insult
a: يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ أَعَيَّرْتَهُ بِأُمِّهِ إِنَّكَ امْرُؤٌ فِيكَ جَاهِلِيَّةٌ، إِخْوَانُكُمْ خَوَلُكُمْ، جَعَلَهُمُ اللَّهُ تَحْتَ أَيْدِيكُمْ
p: Yā Abā Dharr, a-ʿayyartahu bi-ummih. Innaka-mruʾun fīka jāhiliyyah. Ikhwānukum khawalukum, jaʿalahumu-Llāhu taḥta aydīkum
m: Abu Dharr, did you insult him about his mother? You are a man with ignorance still in you. Those who serve you are your brothers. Allah has placed them under your hand.
